input.current_sentence: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
input.context_before: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
input.context_after: Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.
input.selected_text: The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.

output.sentence_type: 并列句，由并列连词 but 连接两个独立分句
output.main_clause: 分句 1：The team has pockets of greatness in design；分句 2：it still struggles to deliver consistently
structure_breakdown: 分句 1：主语 The team + 谓语 has + 宾语 pockets of greatness + 状语 in design
分句 2：主语 it + 谓语 struggles + 状语 still + 不定式短语 to deliver consistently 作补足语
两个独立分句由并列连词 but 连接，形成并列结构
logic_relations: 前后分句为转折关系：先肯定团队在设计上的局部优势，再指出整体交付不稳定的问题
与前句“客观评估团队表现”相呼应，是对评估结论的具体展开
information_hierarchy: 先给出正面评价：团队在设计领域存在局部优势
再通过 but 转折，指出核心问题：难以稳定交付
style_features: 句式简洁，用 but 形成鲜明对比，符合职场复盘的客观语气
用词克制，既肯定成绩又指出问题，避免绝对化表述
grammar_points: pockets of greatness 为名词短语，作 has 的宾语，表“局部优势”
to deliver consistently 为不定式短语，作 struggles 的补足语，表“难以做到的事”
副词 consistently 修饰 deliver，表“稳定地交付”
wording_notes: pockets of greatness 为比喻用法，指“零散的、局部的优势”，而非整体优秀
deliver 在此为职场常用动词，表“交付成果、兑现承诺”

translations.label: 直译
translations.text: 这个团队在设计方面有一些局部的优势，但它仍然难以稳定地交付。

translations.label: 意译
translations.text: 团队在设计上有亮点，但整体交付不够稳定。

translation_notes: pockets of greatness 不宜直译为“伟大的口袋”，应意译为“局部优势、亮点”
evidence: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.
The team has pockets of greatness in design, but it still struggles to deliver consistently.
Our next step is to make those strengths part of our everyday process.
